implementation.summary: Memory startup now negotiates schema metadata explicitly, rejects newer and malformed schemas before DDL can reinterpret them, and exposes the existing backend as deterministic lexical matching.
implementation.migration_policy: No older schema is silently accepted; a future migration must be explicitly registered and run inside a transaction. Unsupported/failed migration state is left unchanged.

backend_contract.matching: Deterministic token/lexical matching over owner/project-scoped learned memory records.
backend_contract.personal_corpus_rag: Separate subsystem; not learned memory and not merged by this phase.
backend_contract.mem0_evaluation: No deterministic local Mem0 evaluation or A/B evidence exists. Prior G2 evidence records mem0ai/mem0 as an architectural reference only; no dependency or provider was added.
backend_contract.experimental_comparison_artifact: This certification records the comparison plan and non-promotion decision; a future semantic backend requires owner-scoped migration tests and deterministic lexical-vs-semantic A/B evidence before promotion.

previous_phase_regression.command: PYTHONPATH=src pytest -q tests/test_corrective_c1_results.py tests/test_corrective_c2_scheduler.py tests/test_corrective_c3_aci.py tests/test_logical_subagents_g11.py tests/test_bounded_aci_g6.py tests/test_memory_g2.py tests/test_repository_context_g4.py tests/test_hooks_g9.py tests/test_laplace_core_g1.py tests/test_zetsu_hotfix_lifecycle.py tests/test_release_v7.py

notes: A newer schema marker is rejected before CREATE IF NOT EXISTS, index creation, or metadata update.
Malformed pre-existing tables are rejected before index DDL can fail ambiguously or reinterpret data.
No memory write path bypasses provenance, explicit intent, approval, owner, or project scope.
No Mem0 dependency, hosted service, cloud inference, or semantic-memory claim was introduced.

delegated_review.note: The bounded reviewer exhausted its step cap without contradictory evidence; Codex source inspection and deterministic tests are authoritative for this gate.

remaining_scope: Repository parser contract remains C5 scope.
Hook timeout safety remains C6 scope.
